title: Your Success Is Our Success: Intuit Connect 2026 remarks
summary: At Intuit Connect 2026, CEO Sasan Goodarzi shares how AI-powered innovations, Intuit Accountant Suite, and Intuit Intelligence are helping accounting firms automate workflows, boost profitability, and accelerate growth.

*The following is adapted from opening remarks at*[Intuit Connect](https://www.intuit.com/intuitconnect/) *on October 26, 2026.*


When you combine what AI makes possible with high human intelligence, everything you’ve ever wanted to architect becomes possible. It’s not easy, but it’s possible. And I don’t believe there will ever be a moment as special as this one for what we can do together.


That’s why I want to focus on how we’re working to enable you to be a force multiplier, and how to unleash your growth in ways you could never imagine possible.


**Accountants are our customers**


Let’s start with a foundational point: accountants are our customers.


In my 22 years at Intuit, we’ve always thought of you, accounting firms, as an important partner and an important channel. Build great products, help you to adopt them, and assist the clients you serve in adopting them too.


That changed more than a year ago. In this era of AI, the best way to power the prosperity of the people we serve is to power your success. We were clear about that with our board, with our investors, and with you. It isn’t a subtle shift. It means we invest billions of dollars every year to build with you and co-create with you. Many of you have been in the kitchen with us already. If you haven’t, you’ll feel the difference in what we’re building, whether it’s live now or coming in the next few weeks or months.


**One platform for both sides of the network**


We’re building a unified, intelligent platform that does two things for you: it drives your top-line growth and improves your profits. The intent is for you to approve decisions and guide the work you want done. It will carry out that work with you always in control. We are building this unified, intelligent platform to serve both sides of the network.


One side is you, through Intuit Accountant Suite, an agnostic platform that helps you manage your firm, your work, your teams, and your clients. The other side is the clients you serve, from a startup of one or two people with an idea to mid-market businesses with several hundred million dollars in revenue.


How is that possible? Think of a three-layer cake.


The first layer, and the most important, is the data platform. It’s your data and your clients’ data, not ours, so privacy and security are of the utmost importance. The platform can take in data from wherever it lives, whether that’s email, a spreadsheet, or a photo of a receipt, and make sure it’s clean.


We have over 625,000 data points per business, including every incoming and outgoing transaction. That tells us how a plumber operates, how a construction company runs, and how a real estate firm works. It’s insightful data, and it feeds the second layer of the cake.


And that second layer is one platform with many apps and workflows that manage lead-to-cash across more than 300 industries, built around accuracy, privacy, and trust.


The third layer is the platform we’ve built to use all of that data, plus our domain expertise and financial capabilities, to automate work and deliver intelligence as directed by you. It’s been built over years to be industry-specific, enterprise-ready, and designed for your firm, with you always in control. Put it all together and it’s one unified platform focused on automation and intelligence. We call it Intuit Intelligence.


**What matters most**


We have been co-creating and co-building with you, and one of the biggest things that you have orchestrated in terms of where our investments have gone is you’ve told us no shiny objects. Let’s go after the biggest things in my firm, whether it’s a small firm or a very large firm that drives significant automation, that helps you improve your efficiency.


Here’s a look at what we’re working on. Some of it is live today, and the rest will be in your hands in the next three to six months.


**Agentic books close.** The biggest thing we’ve heard from you is how much manual work goes into managing transactions all month and closing the books at the end of it. Every firm has its own standard operating procedures. With agentic books close, you upload yours and the agent does the work your way, shows its progress, and flags what needs your attention. It can even prepare the financial summary for your client. Firms testing it in beta say the time savings are the most striking part, and many call it a game changer.


**Agent Studio.** Agent Studio lets you build your own workflows. It’s part of Intuit Accountant Suite, and it brings together our platform, your expertise, and your firm’s procedures so you can create, deploy, and monitor agents for the work that matters most to you. Say you serve construction clients and want a consistent way to track and hold back retainage until project milestones are met. Instead of building separate workflows for each client, you tell the platform what you need and deploy it across your construction clients. We’re building this with about 20 firms, and some already have agents running. You don’t have to be technical to do it.


**Advisory insights.** You’d like to know which of your clients expenses suddenly look off, whose profits are trending down, and who’s doing well enough to invest. So we’re building a team of agents that watch across your client base, surface those anomalies and trends, suggest what to do, and put together an advisory package based on your firm’s preferences. You review it, give feedback, and tell it what to do next. Think of it as a team of brilliant agents and humans working with you, and you’re the one directing them.


**New clients.** We bring thousands of new businesses onto our platform every week. And our data shows that when a customer is connected to one of you, their business performs better and they stay with us longer. So we built a way to match the right customers to your firm, based on how you define a good fit, at the right moment in their business. When a business reaches a certain level of complexity, QuickBooks will encourage them to find an accountant and will match them with firms that fit their needs. They choose who to connect with, and relevant leads show up in Intuit Accountant Suite.


**An agnostic platform.** Intuit is a platform company that helps you manage your firm, your work, your teams, and your clients, and that means connecting to ledgers that aren’t ours. If your firm uses Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT as core AI capabilities, you should be able to connect it to Intuit Accountant Suite, with conversations and memory carrying over in both directions. For example, you could ask Claude which clients need your attention. It would call on Intuit Accountant Suite to pull data from your clients’ general ledgers and connected apps in order to run the analysis. It will surface insights, recommend next steps, and with your approval, take action on your behalf to help your clients get back on track. With Intuit Accountant Suite, you’ll be able to run your firm your way across the ledgers, apps, and the AI platforms you use every day.


**Intelligence for your clients**


The other side of the network is the businesses you serve. Business owners can ask questions like, can I hire another employee? Can I buy more inventory? What are my largest expenses, and how do they compare to my peers? But intelligence can only go so far. Sometimes the right move is connecting that business owner to you, because your judgment and perspective matter to their success. The more they use it, give it feedback, and treat it like a person, the smarter it gets.


We bet years ago that to serve mid-market businesses, which we define as $10 million to several hundred million dollars in revenue, we had to be enterprise-ready and industry-specific. Those customers still need an easy experience and a cost of ownership that makes sense for a business of that size. Intuit Enterprise Suite includes a CFO Command Center, which gives a nonprofit, for example, a consolidated view across entities with custom KPIs and agents for grant management and fund tracking. A manufacturer gets real-time inventory signals and agents tailored to how it works.


**The proof**


Proof points matter, and the numbers tell part of the story.


- More than 260,000 firms use Intuit Accountant Suite. They’re saving more than nine hours per month per client, and many report spending 30% more of their time on advisory work instead of manual work.
- On the mid-market side, more than 25,000 businesses with over $20 million in revenue are on the platform. They’re saving about two days per month.
- Half of the service-based businesses we serve report improved profitability since moving to Intuit Enterprise Suite.


Everything we build comes back to two outcomes: top-line growth and efficiency, which becomes profit growth.


**Creating the future together**


It all comes back to one intelligent platform that serves both sides of the network. Intuit Accountant Suite helps you manage your firm, your work, your teams, and your clients, while businesses get the tools to grow and run their business. At the end of the day, the prosperity of those that we serve depends on you, which is why we’re investing so much in helping you thrive and grow.


We are in an extraordinary moment in the era of AI. Everything you wanted to architect before, you can architect now. Everything and anything is possible as long as we reinvent ourselves and focus on what makes tomorrow possible. They say to create the future and to predict the future, you must create it. And that’s what we are going to do. I can’t wait to see how we build and co-create together.

## Written by


[Sasan Goodarzi](https://www.intuit.com/blog/author/sasan-goodarzi/)


Intuit is on a mission to power prosperity around the world. Under Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Sasan Goodarzi, Intuit has transformed from a tax and accounting platform company into an AI-driven expert platform company. Intuit's powerful combination of proprietary data, domain-specific AI platform capabilities, and AI-powered human expertise is setting the standard for trusted financial intelligence. Sasan’s leadership and operational effectiveness drives Intuit’s vision to bring together data, AI, and human expertise into a single system of intelligence that does the work for customers. Intuit's platform enables businesses to manage from lead to cash, and consumers from credit building to wealth building, all in one place, so they can make high-stakes financial decisions with confidence.


Since becoming CEO in 2019, Intuit has seen record revenue growth and earned recognition from Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, and others as a leader in AI innovation and as one of the world's top places to work. In 2026, Intuit was named to Fortune’s Best Companies to Work For and Most Innovative Companies lists, TIME’s Most Iconic Companies, and Newsweek’s Most Trustworthy Companies.


Before becoming CEO, Sasan led Intuit's two biggest businesses – its consumer group and its global business solutions group. His previous roles at Intuit include serving as chief information officer, where he led Intuit’s transformation to the cloud, as well as general manager of Intuit’s ProTax and Financial Services Division.


Sasan is passionate about authentic leadership, driving a culture of speed and growth, and how innovation can solve customers' financial challenges. He regularly writes and speaks about the importance of bringing data, AI and human expertise to consumers, small and mid-market businesses and accountants, so they can make the best financial choices to help them prosper.


Together with his wife, Shirin, Sasan established the Goodarzi Scholarship Grant, a program designed to provide financial assistance to California female technology students of Iranian descent who have migrated to the United States within the last seven years.
